question: Grupo Oleo Lab avocado oil company parent owner
markdown:
Grupo Oleo Lab
(officially
Grupo Oleo Lab, S.A. de C.V.
) is an independent, privately held B2B Mexican company founded in 2000 and based in Michoacán, Mexico. It operates as its own parent corporate entity specializing in the extraction, processing, and supply of natural plant-based oils, primarily avocado oil.
